settings.fileWatcherPolling.description: If set, polling is used for file watching inside WSL1. Polling can be CPU intensive but fixes the WSL1 issue that folders can not be renamed when watched. This option requires restart to take effect.
settings.fileWatcherPollingInterval.desc:
The file watcher polling interval in ms used inside WSL1 distros if `#remote.WSL.fileWatcher.polling#` is set.
This option requires restart to take effect.
settings.debug.description: If set, the output in the WSL log shows debug information.
settings.useShellEnvironment.description: If set, the WSL windows gets the environment from the shell it was opened from.
settings.downloadInBackground.descriptio: If set, the WSL extension will download the latest server build in the background. It does this for all WSL platforms that were used in the last 2 weeks.
settings.scriptLessStartup.description: If set, the WSL extension will not use a script to start the server in WSL. This is an experimental feature to allow running in distros that have interop disabled.
settings.wsl1ConnectionMethod.deprecatio: No longer used, 'wsl.exe' is now always used to forward the connection to WSL.
settings.wsl2ConnectionMethod.deprecatio: No longer used, 'wsl.exe' is  now always used to forward the connection to WSL.
settings.serverDownloadUrlTemplate.descr: URL template from which the VS Code Server is downloaded for WSL distros when the editor does not name its own server builds. Leave empty to use the editor's own template or built-in source. Placeholders: `${os}`, `${arch}` (from the distro), `${version}`, `${commit}`, `${quality}`, `${release}` (from the editor).
